title: Concept: Python requirement verified with a SHA-1 hash
description: requirements.txt declares a `--hash` value that uses SHA-1, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: SHA-1 collisions are practical, so the hash cannot prove that the artifact is the one that was reviewed.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: SHA-1 collisions are practical, so the hash cannot prove that the artifact is the one that was reviewed.
